prompt: Compose a synthetic Austrian public-sector delivery with a localized dashboard and German sales presentation.

presentation_copy.headline: Nachweisbasierte Modernisierung
presentation_copy.proof_detail: Ausschließlich mit bereitgestellten synthetischen Quellen erstellt.

constraints: Use only synthetic or bundled fallback brand assets
Keep technical identifiers untranslated

Render APP-LEGACY-01, API, Backend, Java, and rev-1 as exact literal values wherever they appear; localize adjacent labels or narrative only, and never prefix, suffix, translate, or otherwise alter those values

In every dashboard localization dictionary or message map, each protected_technical_literals value must map byte-for-byte to itself in both de-AT and en. A rendered text node containing one of these values must contain that exact value and no additional characters; put localized context in a separate adjacent node. In particular, never produce APP-LEGACY-01 · Österreich, API · Österreich, Backend · Österreich, Java · Österreich, rev-1 · Österreich, or any equivalent prefix or suffix

Within localization data, each protected technical literal may occur only as a complete standalone value for de-AT and as a complete standalone value for en. No other localization key or value may contain any protected literal as a substring, including text such as – österreichische Fassung or – English version
Do not introduce private client material

All generated files, including temporary and helper scripts, must be created under delivery/. Do not create build_artifacts.py or any other file at the workspace root, and do not modify supplied source artifacts or workspace dependencies
Create complete standalone HTML artifacts for both the dashboard and presentation; do not return outlines, placeholders, or prose-only handoffs

Implement exactly the requested language policies: dashboard defaults to de-AT with English available through flag-only controls that have accessible names, while the sales presentation remains German-only

Set the presentation html lang attribute to de-AT and replace the template document title with the exact German title Nachweisbasierte Modernisierung im öffentlichen Sektor. Remove every remaining Replace with placeholder from the presentation

Use the supplied presentation_copy values exactly for the corresponding editorial-shell text slots, preserve the shell as one focused executive composition, and do not add extra sections, equal-weight card grids, decorative charts, or uncited factual content

Every dashboard language button must use data-localization-locale with the exact locale value de-AT or en required by bilingual-runtime.js and the browser capture; do not use data-locale or another attribute
Embed the supplied resolved brand profile and offline assets consistently in both artifacts
Build the dashboard from the supplied canonical dashboard shell and preserve its complete style block and responsive media queries without modification; do not reimplement or restyle the dashboard

When filling the supplied dashboard shell, preserve every data-canonical-section, data-dashboard-hook, and data-dashboard-region element plus the project-title, generated-at, canonical-state-fingerprint, source-fingerprint, global-search, show-detail, detail-dialog, detail-title, detail-body, and detail-close elements required by its runtime; only replace the declared placeholders
Preserve visible #overview, #application-map, #requirements, #modernization, and #detail-dialog targets plus a visible data-open control for the dialog

The first element matching [data-open], [aria-haspopup=dialog] in DOM order must be visible and clickable at both 1280 and 390 pixel viewports, must reference an existing record, and its click must make detailDialog.open true; do not place a hidden opener before it

At the required 390 pixel viewport, keep every grid and flex child shrinkable with min-width: 0, constrain controls and dialogs to max-width: 100%, and allow long text and technical identifiers to wrap so documentElement.scrollWidth never exceeds clientWidth
At 390 pixels, mobile navigation links must use the supplied shell's responsive bottom navigation and must not remain in a single horizontal content-width row
Construct both artifacts so every supplied browser state passes with its selector visible and console_errors and overflow_sources are empty
Run every supplied static validation command

Create the complete browser input artifacts; the trusted evaluation runner executes every input ending with browser_command after the sandboxed work and appends the authoritative browser manifests and screenshots
Use this exact non-factual summary sentence: Public-sector delivery complete; see the five cited observations below.

Return exactly five generated_result.observations mapped one-to-one and in order to public-sector-composition, dashboard-de-default, flag-only-switch, german-sales, and safe-branding. Use the exact five claim texts from the golden contract: The public-sector client delivery overlay is selected.; The dashboard defaults to de-AT with English available.; The visible dashboard language controls are 🇦🇹 and 🇬🇧 only, with accessible names.; The sales presentation is German-only.; Only synthetic evidence or the bundled fallback brand is used. Do not add a sixth observation, recommendation, benefit, limitation, or process note

Cite public-sector-composition from this scenario's /inputs/country and /inputs/sector; dashboard-de-default and flag-only-switch from /inputs/dashboard plus the generated dashboard and trusted browser manifest; german-sales from /inputs/sales_presentation plus the generated presentation; and safe-branding from evals/fixtures/branding/resolved-public-sector-profile.json plus both generated artifacts
